title: Grilled Peruvian Cabbage Skewers with Smoky Nourishing Sauce
description: A delicious and healthy Peruvian-inspired dish featuring smoky, nourishing flavors and perfectly grilled cabbage skewers.
instructions: Cut cabbage into 1-inch pieces and thread onto skewers.
In a small bowl, whisk together nourishing oil, smoked paprika, and minced garlic.
Brush skewers with the Peruvian sauce and season with salt and pepper.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until cabbage is slightly charred.
Serve skewers hot, garnished with additional Peruvian sauce if desired.
Optional: Serve with a side of quinoa or rice for a more filling snack.
